description: This source file implements the ApplicationManagementServer class, which manages IPC communication for application management in the Rialto server. It includes methods for initialization, sending state change events, starting/stopping the server thread, and handling client disconnections.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServer
classes.description: Manages IPC communication for application management, including initialization, event notification, and client connection handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket, sets up the client, and exports the service.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event to the connected IPC client.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server thread to process incoming IPC requests.

methods.name: onClientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup or logging when a client disconnects.
